definitions.explanation: A colloquial clipping of {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ} (carbohydrate), used mainly in dieting and fitness talk to refer to carb-rich foods such as rice, bread, and noodles.

examples.japanese: {炭水|たんすい}を{控|ひか}える。
{夜|よる}は{炭水|たんすい}を{減|へ}らすようにしている。
examples.english: I try to cut down on carbs at night.

examples.japanese: ダイエット{中|ちゅう}は{炭水|たんすい}を{抜|ぬ}く{人|ひと}も{多|おお}いが、{抜|ぬ}きすぎは{体|からだ}に{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: Many people cut carbs while dieting, but cutting too much is bad for the body.

notes:
A casual shortening of {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}, common in conversation about diet and exercise. In formal or written contexts use the full word {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炭水|たんすい}を{抜|ぬ}く: to cut out carbs
- {炭水|たんすい}を{控|ひか}える: to go easy on carbs
- {炭水|たんすい}{抜|ぬ}きダイエット: a low-carb diet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}: carbohydrate — the full, standard term.
